scope: middle and final saved first/third-person frames of all 20 cases; not continuous temporal certification

observations.BallKick: Ball and feet visible in both views; native displacement result retained.
observations.ChairPush: Hands at chair back; chair visibly tilts; preserve native tilt-check outcome and raw state for review.
observations.ChairSit: Seated pelvis over chair at final frame; head view naturally does not show seat contact.
observations.DollyPush: Both hands visible on handle; trolley moves; first/third views complementary.
observations.GroundBasketPick: Basket tilted near knees; no hand contact in physical trace, invalid grasp despite native height pass.
observations.TableApplePick: No completed grasp at final state; small target poorly resolved in overview.
observations.TableButtonPress: Hand near button; native required force/hold was not reached.
observations.GroundBottlePick: Target is small/partly occluded after failed interaction; no claimed pickup.
observations.GroundBoxPick: Hands near box top/sides; no measured successful lift.
observations.TablePlatePick: Hands reach plate region; final plate not lifted to native success height.
observations.ReferenceBall: Foot-ball interaction and displaced ball visible; original success retained.
observations.ReferenceChairPush: Chair contact then hands separate; native displacement criterion not reached.
observations.ReferenceChairSit: Robot turns beside chair but does not achieve accepted seated state.
observations.ReferenceDolly: Hands approach handle, but final native displacement criterion not reached.
observations.ReferenceBasket: Hands do not form a completed supported lift; basket remains on ground.
observations.ReferenceBottle: Bottle remains standing/near its ground start region; hands fail to complete pickup.
observations.ReferenceBox: Hands approach box but no accepted lift; ground support remains visible.
observations.ReferenceApple: Hands reach tabletop edge; no visibly completed pickup in sampled final state, consistent with measured failure.
observations.ReferenceButton: Hands approach table/button region; sampled images cannot establish required force or hold; native checker fails.
observations.ReferencePlate: Both hands approach plate near tabletop edge; no accepted lift in measured state.

limitations: Checkerboard native MuJoCo scenes, not photorealistic Isaac rendering.
Sampled frames cannot rule out temporal jitter.
Task success relies on state/contact evidence, not image appearance.
